title: rosa fraxinoides
intro: Rosa fraxinoides, commonly known as the "Manzanita rose" or "Mountain rose", is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health issues such as arthritis, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rosa fraxinoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
